items.question: Which customer segment has the highest churn rate?
items.sql: WITH max_date AS (SELECT MAX(order_date) AS max_ord FROM orders), customer_last_order AS (SELECT c.customer_id, c.segment, MAX(o.order_date) AS last_order_date FROM customers AS c LEFT JOIN orders AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.segment) SELECT clo.segment, COUNT(*) AS total_customers, SUM(CASE WHEN clo.last_order_date IS NULL OR clo.last_order_date < DATE((SELECT max_ord FROM max_date), '-6 months') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS churned_customers, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN clo.last_order_date IS NULL OR clo.last_order_date < DATE((SELECT max_ord FROM max_date), '-6 months') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(*) AS churn_rate FROM customer_last_order AS clo GROUP BY clo.segment ORDER BY churn_rate DESC LIMIT 500

items.question: Which product category drove the revenue decline from Q2 to Q3 2025?
items.sql: SELECT p.category, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-06-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) AS q2_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-09-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) AS q3_revenue, SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-09-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_date >= '2025-04-01' AND o.order_date <= '2025-06-30' THEN oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount) ELSE 0 END) AS revenue_change FROM order_items AS oi JOIN products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN orders AS o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND (o.order_date BETWEEN '2025-04-01' AND '2025-09-30') GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY revenue_change ASC LIMIT 500
